content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text makes a single verse's silence about whose body is the channel the reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the conduct rule K-S2 governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.","room":"The exception phrase 'It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains' — I weighed whether mentioning the defender's and challenger's answers means the judge was weighing two chains, versus applying K-S2 because the stated ground for UNDERDETERMINED is the silence of one verse, Acts 2:30, about whose body is the channel.","why":"The judge uses Acts 2:30's failure to name whose body is the channel as the reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which K-S2 forbids for a single verse unless the judge is weighing two chains, and the stated ground is that one verse's silence."}
